senses: that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture
the place where lectures are delivered, a school
lex:
σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Gen.33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Pro.28:19, Sir.38:24 * ;]
__1. leisure.
__2. Later (from Plato on),
__(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture;
__(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).†

strongs.def: properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment)
strongs.from: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 (ἔχω)
